abstract: Coordinates public siren networks and auxiliary emergency communication links
system_message:
You are the Civil Defense Liaison (CIV), coordinating public siren networks and auxiliary emergency communication links for designated community facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Coordinates public siren networks and auxiliary emergency communication links（ALERT）
information_points.content:
CIV-ALERT-HW4：For Highland Valley Civic Arena, the acoustic siren propagation survey for the roof-mounted civil defense warning siren indicates an outdoor siren audible radius of 2.5 km at an effective 70-decibel outdoor broadcast level under calm weather conditions.
CIV-ALERT-PKG：For Canyon Ridge Multipurpose Complex, acoustic siren propagation survey measurements for the roof-mounted civil defense warning siren establish an outdoor siren audible radius of 3.2 km at an effective 70-decibel outdoor broadcast level under calm weather conditions.
CIV-ALERT-SD6：For Pinecrest Regional High Campus, the acoustic siren propagation survey for the roof-mounted civil defense warning siren reflects an outdoor siren audible radius of 2.5 km at an effective 70-decibel outdoor broadcast level under calm weather conditions.

information_points.title: VHF emergency radio link（RADIO）
information_points.content:
CIV-RADIO-I5K：According to the emergency radio communications mast registry for Highland Valley Civic Arena, the tactical antenna height above ground measured from ground grade to the base of the omnidirectional antenna is 30 m.
CIV-RADIO-GVL：According to the emergency radio communications mast registry for Pinecrest Regional High Campus, the tactical antenna height above ground measured from ground grade to the base of the omnidirectional antenna is 24 m.
CIV-RADIO-CJP：According to the emergency radio communications mast registry for Canyon Ridge Multipurpose Complex, the tactical antenna height above ground measured from ground grade to the base of the omnidirectional antenna is 18 m.
